claim: Applying a discount to an order that already has a discount must not compound the reduction a second time.
Attempting to apply a discount to a delivered order must return 400.
Attempting to apply a discount to a cancelled order must return 400.
The discount_percent recorded on the order must reflect the actual percentage reduction applied to the original order total.
Applying a discount to one order must leave every other order's total and discount_percent completely unchanged.
